question:
Which of the following is a humorous edit of this artist or movie name: 'dream theater'?
Options:
(A) tdream theater
(B) dreaml theater
(C) cream theater
(D) dream theatpr

Option A: tdream theater.

Option D: dream theatpr.

The other options don't seem to have that kind of wordplay.
So I think the answer is C.
